name: rentemester-corporate-record-scope-integrity-v23
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER rm_corporate_record_links_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON rm_corporate_record_links BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'corporate record links are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER rm_corporate_record_links_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON rm_corporate_record_links BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'corporate record links are append-only'); END;
